exposure: Nulliparous women with a term singleton cephalic fetus (groups 1, 2, and 3)
Nippita 10-group classification (based on parity, gestational age, number of fetuses, fetal presentation, and previous cesarean delivery)
finding: Nulliparous women with a term singleton cephalic fetus and an unfavorable cervix represent the population to target for auditing induction practices and improving labor induction management.
